text: No, it is not valid. The June 2025 due diligence correctly reported no detected loss, but new evidence shows a **13.5-hectare tree-cover loss event in 2025**, pending corroboration. The loss occurred in a native forest context and is supported by the Hansen GFC dataset, with high agreement (98%) from the JRC 2020 reference. While the cause and persistence are not yet confirmed, the preliminary finding means the property is no longer free of post-2020 loss. Further monitoring in 2026 will be needed to confirm if the loss is permanent.
